title: What If You Floated Into Space Without a Suit?

scenes.text: What if you floated into space with no suit? You wouldn't explode. The truth is stranger.
Exhale first. Holding your breath would let the air in your lungs expand and tear them.
In about ten seconds, water in your tissues starts turning to vapor. Your body swells, and your tongue's moisture bubbles.
Around fifteen seconds, you black out. A technician in a 1966 NASA test stayed aware for about fourteen.
Your skin is elastic enough to hold you together, and your blood stays liquid under pressure.
The twist: if you're rescued within a minute or two, you could fully recover.

description:
What if you floated into space without a suit?
No explosion and no instant freeze, but about fifteen seconds before you black out.
